listen.title: Listen
listen.description:
Listening

Tap Play to start. What you hear is a mix of the recordings people have made here, blended live as you listen, so it is never quite the same twice.

Use the toggle at the bottom of the screen to choose how you listen. In map mode, drag the map to listen anywhere. In walk mode, the map follows your phone's location and the sound changes as you move.

Each marker or shape on the map is someone's contribution. Tap one to see it, and to hear it on its own.

To add your own, tap the record button on the map.

tags.title: Describe your recording
tags.description:
Describe your recording

Choose the options that best describe what you're about to record. They help listeners find it, and some projects use them to decide what plays where.

Tap Next when you're done. You can go back and change your choices before you submit.

location.title: Choose a location
location.description:
Choose a location

Your recording will be placed on the map here, and heard by people listening nearby.

Tap Use my location to place it where you are, or search for a place and move the map to pick a spot. Then tap Next.

record.title: Make a recording
record.description:
Making a recording

Tap the microphone to start recording, and tap again to stop. The first time, your browser will ask for permission to use the microphone.

Listen back before you decide to keep it. Not happy? Tap Delete and try again.

If the project allows it, Add Media attaches a photo or some text to your recording.

When you're ready, tap Submit. After you agree to the project's terms, your recording is added to the map.

loop-start.title: Add your part
loop-start.description:
Adding your part

In this project, recordings play together as one piece that loops continuously. You'll hear the loop, record along with it, and hear how your part sounds in the mix before you decide to keep it.

Headphones help: without them, your microphone may pick up the loop as well as you.

The first time, your browser will ask for permission to use the microphone.

rehearse.title: Get to know the loop
rehearse.description:
Get to know the loop

Tap Play to hear the loop you'll be recording with. Listen as many times as you like.

When you're ready, tap Record.

recording.title: Recording
recording.description:
Recording

Recording starts after a short countdown, in time with the loop, and stops by itself when the loop comes round to the end. The circle shows how far along you are.

The level meter tells you if you're too quiet or too loud.

review.title: Review
review.description:
Listen back

You're hearing your part mixed with the loop.

Want another go? Record again. Happy with it? Tap Submit to add it to the project; it may take a loop or two before you hear it with everyone else.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.description:
Welcome

Tap the ? on any screen for help with that screen.
